opportunities.opportunity_title: Rural Communities Opioid Response Program – Implementation
opportunities.top_level_agency_name: Department of Health and Human Services

summary.summary_description: This program funds rural communities to strengthen and expand prevention, treatment, and recovery services for substance use disorder. Recipients form consortiums with at least three other organizations and serve areas designated as rural by the Federal Office of Rural Health Policy. Rural clinics can expand addiction treatment through coordinated prevention, treatment, and recovery services.
summary.applicant_eligibility_description: Eligible applicants include nonprofits, local governments, tribal governments, and public universities. Rural community health clinics and consortium members may participate in coordinated addiction treatment programs and expand services to meet local needs.
summary.agency_contact_description: Morgan Ellis, Rural Health Grants Desk; (301) 555-0142; ruralopioid@sample.grants.example

competitions.competition_title: Implementation

summary.applicant_eligibility_description: Nonprofits, local governments, and tribal governments serving rural communities may apply.
